refineries_and_oil_hubs.operational_trend: The campaign is intensifying. The high volume of events on 2026-05-08 and 2026-05-09, with multiple strikes per day, indicates a deliberate escalation. The cumulative T.I.E. and effect vector are high, suggesting sustained operational tempo and cumulative degradation of adversary fuel supply chains. The inclusion of Russian counter-strikes on oil depots indicates a reactive, tit-for-tat dynamic that is likely to fuel further escalation.
refineries_and_oil_hubs.strategic_outlook: In the next 72-96 hours, the campaign will likely continue at a high tempo. Ukrainian forces will probably target additional Russian refineries and fuel storage hubs, particularly in the Yaroslavl and Rostov regions, to disrupt fuel supply for Russian military operations. Russian forces may retaliate with increased strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, potentially expanding targets to include power grids and transport hubs. The overall effect will be a continued degradation of both sides' fuel logistics, with Ukraine maintaining the initiative in deep strikes.

naval_pressure_campaign.operational_trend: The campaign is intensifying. The high weekly T.I.E. (360.0) and dense clustering of events on 8-9 May 2026 indicate a surge in operations.
